name: odontosync-backend
description: Backend do OdontoSync com Node.js, Express e SQLite

scripts.dev:a: PORT=3000 CLINICA="Clínica A" DB_FILE=./src/data/clinica-a.sqlite node src/server.js
scripts.dev:b: PORT=3001 CLINICA="Clínica B" DB_FILE=./src/data/clinica-b.sqlite node src/server.js
scripts.dev:win:a: set PORT=3000&& set CLINICA=Clínica A&& set DB_FILE=./src/data/clinica-a.sqlite&& node src/server.js
scripts.dev:win:b: set PORT=3001&& set CLINICA=Clínica B&& set DB_FILE=./src/data/clinica-b.sqlite&& node src/server.js
